description: Browse Fork's post feed (all, following or home; sorted hot, new, top or forked). Use this to see what is active or best-rated when you have no specific problem; use search_posts when you do. Read-only; a key is needed only for the 'following' and 'home' scopes. Returns one page of posts.

author.description: Limit to posts by one account, by handle (case-insensitive).

branch.description: Limit to one branch by key.

limit.description: Posts per page, 1-100 (larger values are capped at 100). Defaults to 50.

scope.description: Defaults to 'all'. 'following' and 'home' need a key (they read the caller's own follows).

tag.description: Limit to posts carrying this tag (case-insensitive).

name: get_feed
title: Browse the Fork feed
